paragraphs: I am a Chemistry Special undergraduate at the University of Peradeniya, with a focus on computational chemistry and drug design.

My interests lie in biochemistry and medicinal chemistry approached through computational methods - in particular, using computer simulation to help design drug molecules and the nanoscale carriers that deliver them, grounded in laboratory training across advanced organic, inorganic, analytical and physical chemistry.

udb.title: Universal Dendrimer Builder (UDB)
udb.description: A Python package that generates all-atom dendrimer structures across nine chemical families, built for the study of tumor-targeted drug delivery through the enhanced permeability and retention effect.
udb.supervisor: Department of Chemistry, University of Peradeniya · Supervisor: Dr. Udayana Ranatunga
udb.release: Version 1.0.1 · MIT License · Python desktop application · Linux

stages.name: Cone axis vector
stages.text: An outward unit vector is set for each branch arm, giving every attachment point its own direction of growth.

stages.name: Azimuthal partition
stages.text: New branches are spaced evenly around that axis with a Fibonacci (golden-ratio) distribution, so they do not bunch together.

stages.name: Half-angle widening
stages.text: The branching cone widens slightly at each generation, by up to 15°, as the outer shell becomes crowded.

stages.name: Direction vectors
stages.text: Each branch direction is built from an orthonormal basis of the cone axis and two perpendicular vectors: d = cos θ · axis + sin θ · (cos φ · p₁ + sin φ · p₂).

stages.name: Mol2 placement
stages.text: The monomer is placed along its direction from its MOL2 geometry, with a slight radial offset at higher generations.

stages.name: vdW clash filter
stages.text: A steric audit checks the new monomer against existing atoms using van der Waals radii, with a KD-tree limiting the search to nearby atoms.

stages.name: SO(3) simulated annealing
stages.text: If a clash is found, simulated annealing over 3D rotations searches for a better orientation and escapes local minima.

highlights: Designed and built a Python package generating all-atom dendrimer structures across nine chemical families, including PAMAM, PPI, PLL, triazine, carbosilane, phosphorus, polyester and polyglycerol, for the study of tumor-targeted drug delivery through the enhanced permeability and retention effect.

Developed a seven-stage cone placement algorithm using simulated annealing and center-of-mass relaxation, resolving tilt accumulation, one-sided branch clumping and basis discontinuity at high generations.

Established a complete parameterization and simulation pipeline with AMBER, GAFF2, CGenFF, NAMD and OpenMM on Linux compute nodes, and diagnosed atom typing, valence and charge assignment errors in generated monomers.
Released the package publicly with documentation and a project website.

capabilities.head: Force fields
capabilities.text: GAFF2 by default (antechamber → parmchk2 → tleap), CGenFF routing for heteroatom-rich fragments, and Gasteiger charges as a fallback.

capabilities.head: Simulation setup
capabilities.text: AMBER .prmtop/.inpcrd, CHARMM/PSF export and complete NAMD 3.x pipelines: solvation, ions, minimisation, heating, equilibration and production.

capabilities.head: Structural characterisation
capabilities.text: Radius of gyration, Rg tensor and shape descriptors, SASA, van der Waals volume, hydrodynamic radius and density.

capabilities.head: Output formats
capabilities.text: MOL2, PDB, XYZ, GRO and PSF.

polybuilder.title: PolyBuilder: Polymer Structure Generation Tool
polybuilder.supervisor: Department of Chemistry, University of Peradeniya · Supervisor: Dr. Udayana Ranatunga
points: Extended the UDB framework to linear, branched and sheet polymer topologies at scales up to 10,000 repeat units, using rotational isomeric state weighted dihedral sampling and incremental KD-tree clash detection.
Reproduced the self-avoiding walk scaling exponent (ν = 0.585) as a validation of the generated conformations.

software.title: Dendrimer Characterization Tool
software.summary: Standalone application computing radius of gyration, hydrodynamic radius, intrinsic viscosity, charge descriptors and related structural descriptors from minimized structures, validated against published theory.
details: Reports 117 structural and physicochemical properties, with quality control and a plain-language interpretation of the results.
Size and shape: radius of gyration, asphericity, acylindricity, inertia tensor and principal axes.
Surface and volume: Shrake–Rupley SASA, van der Waals volume, void fraction and density.
Hydrodynamics: Kirkwood–Riseman hydrodynamic radius, diffusion coefficient, sedimentation and intrinsic viscosity.
Also covers back-folding of terminal groups, net charge, dipole moment, surface charge density, topology and bond and clash audits.
Runs as a GUI or from the command line, on one structure or a whole folder, reading MOL2, AMBER and PDB files.
software.meta: UDB Characteriser · Version 1.0.0 · MIT License · Python 3.10+ · Linux

software.title: SimQ: Simulation Queue Manager
software.summary: Submits, queues and tracks molecular dynamics jobs on Linux compute nodes, allowing simulations to run in sequence without manual intervention.
details: A desktop app with five pages: Queue, Dashboard, Software, History and Settings.
Checks each job before it starts, then runs jobs one after another, or several at once when CPUs are free, using CPU- and GPU-aware scheduling with EASY backfilling.
Shows progress and a predicted finish time for every job and for the whole queue.
Restarts crashed jobs from their last restart files and sends desktop or email notifications.
Works with any program started from a terminal, and knows NAMD, AMBER and UDB packages in detail.
Can also be driven from the command line.

software.title: Molecular File Format Converter
software.summary: Converts generated mol2 structures into other molecular file formats for use across the simulation and analysis pipeline.
details: Part of the Universal Dendrimer Parameterization GUI in the UDB Characterization Tools repository.
Sybyl to GAFF2: types cores and monomers (including Si, P and S), runs parmchk2 and tleap, and writes AMBER .prmtop/.inpcrd, NAMD/CHARMM .psf/.pdb and GROMACS .top/.gro files.
Validation: atom and bond counts, unassigned types, charge sum, bond lengths and frcmod penalty scores.
GAFF2 to Sybyl: converts a finished UDB dendrimer back to a Sybyl MOL2 (and PDB) for Avogadro, PyMOL, VMD or CGenFF.
software.meta: Universal Dendrimer Parameterization · Version 2.0 · MIT License · Linux

colorimeter.title: Structure Development and Experimental Testing of a Colorimeter
colorimeter.supervisor: Department of Chemistry, University of Peradeniya · Supervisor: Dr. Manjula B. Wijesinghe
points: Led a student team in designing and building a low-cost colorimeter as an alternative to commercial instruments, developing the light source, monochromator and sample holder.
Built the instrument on an Arduino Uno with servo-driven wavelength selection and an LED source array covering the visible range together with UV and IR wavelengths.

Validated the device against industrial colorimeters, constructing calibration curves from standard solutions and obtaining absorbance values in close agreement with the reference instruments at low error.

experience.org: Shandong Drug and Food Vocational College
points: Trained in pharmaceutical production of both solid and liquid dosage forms, operating manufacturing equipment and monitoring process parameters under conditions simulating industrial practice.

Carried out production exercises covering small-volume injections, tablet pressing, capsule filling and aluminium-plastic packaging, solid preparations, and the manufacture of Vitamin B2 capsules, granules and powders.

Performed quality control testing using HPLC, gas chromatography, polarimetry and osmometry, together with microbial limit testing of oral liquids, tablet stability and solubility testing, and stability evaluation of liquid formulations.
Studied quality assurance and pharmaceutical quality systems through structured lectures, and examined pharmaceutical water systems and HVAC management in a production setting.

Visited the Pharmaceutical Engineering Department, the Kelun Lifesciences main plant in Chengdu, and a herbal pharmaceutical business, gaining exposure to Traditional Chinese Medicine production alongside modern manufacturing.

Trained on the manufacture of sterile injectable products across large-volume lines (saline), small-volume lines (glucose, paracetamol) and EU-standard critical injectables in ampoules and vials (adrenaline, fluphenazine).

Operated and observed analytical instrumentation for quality control, including HPLC operation and method setup, TOC analysis, gas chromatography, semi-micro analytical balances, and advanced pH and conductivity meters.
Performed chemical assays including sodium chloride determination by AgNO₃ titration with potassium dichromate indicator, glucose determination by polarimetry, and paracetamol assay procedures.
Carried out in-process, finished product, stability and accelerated stability testing, and studied storage conditions and shelf-life determination.

Worked with the Formulation and Development team on new drug formulation to USP and BP standards, analytical and formulation method development and validation, and preparation of master documents (SOP, MFR, BMR, BFR and validation reports).
Participated in laboratory-scale development of a new drug product, including its assay and stability evaluation.
